# teams_video_interop_service_provider (Resource)

Manages the VideoInteropServiceProvider policy via New-CsVideoInteropServiceProvider / Get-CsVideoInteropServiceProvider / Set-CsVideoInteropServiceProvider / Remove-CsVideoInteropServiceProvider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `aad_application_ids` (String) Maps to the -AadApplicationIds parameter.
- `allow_app_guest_joins_as_authenticated` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowAppGuestJoinsAsAuthenticated parameter.
- `instruction_uri` (String) Maps to the -InstructionUri parameter.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
- `tenant_key` (String) Maps to the -TenantKey parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
